problem: Find all of the subsets of $U={-\pi ,\pi }.$
worked_solution:
To find every subset of $U,$ we list out every combination of elements within $U.$ 

We can use the following diagram to visualize the process:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071627/assets/b0e483a2d10cba17fb2bd3bf0e78d7b4d2fc07b22dbb5c492564b998bbfce6fc.png)

Note that we must include the empty set since it is a subset of every set.

By doing this, we get

$$
∅,{-\pi },{\pi },{-\pi ,\pi }.
$$
